{{Quote|Make your way through the Star Destroyer ''Intrepid''<nowiki></nowiki>'s TIE fighter defenses. Then destroy both of the ''Intrepid''<nowiki></nowiki>'s Shield Generator Towers. A-wings will escort you in, while the Y-wings make a frontal assault.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] briefing|<ref name="XW" />}}
The '''Battle of the Circarpous system''' was a series of raids conducted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces from the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] that resulted in the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Intrepid (Imperial I-class)|''Intrepid'']].

==Prelude==
The ''Intrepid'' was witness when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] freighter [[Phoenix (BFF-1 bulk freighter)|''Phoenix'']] [[Battle of Orron III|stole]] some [[communications satellite]]s from the Imperial base on [[Orron III]] and was unable to stop them. The next week the ''Intrepid'' attempted to destroy the ''Phoenix'' while it awaited the arrival of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Maximus]]''. The Imperial attack was interrupted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in an [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] who held off the Imperial fighters until the ''Maximus'' arrived. Shortly after the ''Maximus's'' arrival, the ''Intrepid'' fled leading the Rebels to conclude that it was suffering from a shortage of pilots or starfighters. Also, the ''Intrepid'' was the last 'witness' of the transmission of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] plans to Rebel hands. Eventually the Alliance saw the opportunity when the ''Intrepid''<nowiki></nowiki>'s [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was damaged in an accidental collision with an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], leaving the ship stranded in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]].<ref name="XW" />

==The battle==
===First phase===
Keyan Farlander flew an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], escorted by two<ref name="OSG">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> R-22 Spearheads,<ref name="R22">The [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] was introduced following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] according to sources released before [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], including the ''[[Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''. ''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' introduced the [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter]] as the basis for the A-wing's design, [[Retroactive continuity|retconning]] the A-wings seen in ''X-Wing'' before the Battle of Yavin. ''[[The Written Word]]'' established "A-wing" as an informal nickname for the older [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] among [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]].</ref> in a raid against freighters from ''[[Kiam]]'' group which were delivering parts to repair the hyperdrive.<ref name="OSG" />

Despite the ''Intrepid'' launching TIEs, the Rebels were able to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|fight]] their way through to the freighters and Farlander identified those carrying the hyperdrive parts, destroying the first with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], before using [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to take out the second while evading fire from the TIE defenders. With the hyperdrive parts destroyed, the Rebels jumped back into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="OSG" />

===Second phase===
With the ''Intrepid'' still stranded and low on fighters, the Empire sent three [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] from [[Viper (corvette group)|''Viper'']] group and several [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] to reinforce it until repairs could be made. The Rebels decided to destroy the reinforcements before they could get close to the ''Intrepid''. Farlander led a group of Y-wings, escorted by [[Ernek Marskan]] in an X-wing, in the mission.<ref name="OSG" />

The Rebels lured the Assault Gunboats away from the [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and eliminated them before moving in on the larger [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Farlander ordered his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] to focus fire on the lead corvette, destroying it with a proton torpedo strike and leaving a gap in the formation. Farlander then targeted one of the remaining corvettes while his wingmates attacked the other. The ''Intrepid'' could do little but watch as its reinforcements were destroyed and the Rebels once more returned to hyperspace.<ref name="OSG" />

===Third phase===
The ''Intrepid'' was now laid defenseless, apart from the last few remaining TIE pilots. The Alliance decided that the time for a major attack had come. Two X-wings from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], flown by Keyan Farlander and [[Sunnar Jan-lo]], were tasked with shooting ''Intrepid''<nowiki></nowiki>'s [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome]]s ahead of a heavy torpedo bombardment from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] Y-wings. [[Samuel Raider]] flew one of two R-22s from [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], which were to engage the TIE defenses and protect the other Rebel craft.<ref name="OSG" />

Though the Rebels lost some of their fighters, including Jan-lo's X-wing, which was destroyed by a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]], the bombardment proved too much and the ''Intrepid'' was eventually destroyed. A patrol of Assault Gunboats arrived too late to save the ''Intrepid'' and the Rebels escaped into hyperspace.<ref name="OSG" />

==Aftermath==
The battle was the first successful destruction of a Star Destroyer due to a Rebel frontal assault.<ref name="XW" /> Jan-lo successfully ejected and was rescued following the battle and taken back to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] for [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment.<ref name="OSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']], in the "Tour of Duty II: The Great Search" missions "Stop Hyperdrive Replacement," "Take Out Intrepid's Escort," and "Destroy the Intrepid."
